candidate_workaround: Keep precommit candidate results unbound to later commits and require exact-head plus clean-state checks for canonical scoped credit.
failure_signature: The first lifecycle builder rebound a precommit candidate receipt to the evidence head without an exact-head test invocation.
recurrence_guard: A scoped-test receipt receives canonical credit only when its runner records the exact HEAD and required clean state during the invocation.
rollback: Withdraw exact-evidence credit additively and preserve the earlier candidate receipt as noncanonical evidence.
scope_boundary: Same-owner revision-binding recovery only; not semantic truth, production certification, or independent reproduction.
title: Bind scoped-test credit to the invoked revision
trigger_preconditions: a receipt predates the commit it is later associated with
